title: Number of Subarrays That Match a Pattern I
accessAttempt: Official leetcode.com page not fetchable (HTTP 403). Statement obtained from leetcode.doocs.org/en/lc/3034/ via WebFetch, which paraphrased it (not verbatim).
summary: Given nums (length n) and pattern (length m, values -1, 0, 1), count subarrays of nums of length m+1 where each adjacent comparison matches pattern: 1 means next is larger, 0 equal, -1 smaller.
visualizationCap: n <= 100 as stated; the visualization runs the full brute-force scan, so it is capped at the stated maximum.
verificationNote: Constraints and examples came from a paraphrasing mirror, not the official statement. Not verified against the official page.
